The answer doesn't list individual subdirectories under `src/` that contain llama.cpp-calling code. It names these:

- `src/inference` is named in the build-link line ("`src/inference/CMakeLists.txt` builds the inference OBJECT library. It links `llama`...") and in the table ("Only `src/inference` and `src/facade`").
- `src/facade` is named in the same two places.

It names `config`, `core`, `mcp`, `types` and `storage` only as directories that do not depend on llama at build time.

ITEMS:
src/inference
src/facade
END
